name: Vamshi Rubber Limited
about: Vamshi Rubber Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of tire retreading materials in India. It provides precured tread rubber, vulcanizing solutions, bonding gums, extruded rope rubber, rubber compound sheets, cushion gum, curing envelopes, CBTR, and cushion gum ropes. The company exports its products. Vamshi Rubber Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
